project.title: PlugFit
project.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform acting as a quality layer for MCP servers, ingesting API specs and serving cleaned, improved endpoints as live MCP endpoints. (Active Development)
resume_points: Built a multi-tenant SaaS platform that acts as a quality layer for MCP servers, ingesting API specs and serving cleaned, improved endpoints.
Architected a custom executor registry and MCP transport layer to serve cleaned specs as live, tenant-isolated MCP endpoints.
Designed an LLM-based cleaning pipeline (Gemini 2.0 Flash) with dynamic resource-vocabulary extraction and async job processing via Celery and Redis.
Implemented a secure auth system with JWT access tokens, httpOnly refresh-token rotation, Google OAuth2, and magic-link verification.

details.architecture: Multi-tenant FastAPI platform with async SQLAlchemy, Celery/Redis job queue, and a custom MCP transport layer serving live tenant-isolated endpoints.
details.challenges: Designing a fully generic cleaning pipeline with dynamic resource vocabulary instead of hardcoded domain terms, and building a reliable async job system for LLM-based processing.
details.security: Implemented JWT access tokens, httpOnly refresh-token cookies with rotation and family-scoped revocation, Google OAuth2 with CSRF state, and magic-link email verification.
details.improvements: Next planned component is F-04, an agent-based eval harness for scoring usability before and after cleaning.

project.title: Windows SIEM
project.description: End-to-end SIEM pipeline that collects Windows telemetry, detects suspicious activity using custom rules, and sends real-time alerts to Telegram and automation workflows.
resume_points: Built a complete SOC pipeline using Sysmon, Winlogbeat, Elasticsearch, Kibana, and ElastAlert2.
Developed detection rules for PowerShell abuse, persistence, process injection, service creation, and suspicious network activity.
Automated deployment using Docker, batch scripts, and environment-based secret management.

details.architecture: Windows host runs Sysmon and Winlogbeat to ship logs into a Dockerized Elastic Stack. ElastAlert2 performs rule-based detections and sends alerts to Telegram and n8n workflows.
details.challenges: Integrating Windows telemetry with containerized ELK stack and handling Telegram API formatting and environment-variable secret management.
details.security: Used environment variables for tokens, separated detection logic from secrets, and implemented automated setup scripts for reproducibility.
details.improvements: Planned additions include threat-intelligence enrichment, Grafana dashboards, multi-host monitoring, and TLS-enabled secure deployment.

project.title: VulnScan
project.description: Language-agnostic dependency vulnerability scanner CLI written in Go, querying OSV.dev to detect and score known vulnerabilities across Go, npm, and Python projects.
resume_points: Built a stdlib-only Go CLI that detects project ecosystems and parses Go, npm, and Python dependency manifests.
Integrated the OSV.dev API for batch vulnerability queries and implemented a CVSS v3.1 base-score calculator from scratch.
Designed a concurrent worker-pool scanner with context-based cancellation, an on-disk TTL cache, and offline scan mode.
Built a pluggable Parser/Provider architecture so new ecosystems and vulnerability databases can be added without touching core logic.

details.architecture: Stdlib-only Go CLI: a detector walks the project tree to identify ecosystems, self-registering Parser implementations extract dependencies, a worker-pool scanner queries pluggable vulnerability Providers (OSV.dev) concurrently, and results are scored and rendered via terminal/JSON/Markdown/CSV reporters.
details.challenges: Designing a CVSS v3.1 base-score calculator from the raw vector spec for advisories that ship a vector but no pre-bucketed severity, and building an extensible Parser/Provider interface so new ecosystems and databases are additive, not invasive.
details.security: Scans dependency manifests against known-vulnerability data (OSV.dev), computes severity and a security score per project, and generates remediation commands as a review-before-you-run script rather than auto-applying fixes.
details.improvements: Planned: Rust/Java/.NET/PHP/Ruby/Docker/Terraform ecosystem parsers, additional providers (GHSA, NVD), SARIF/HTML output, SBOM generation (CycloneDX/SPDX), typosquat/malicious-package detection, and CI templates.
